source_identity: Parisian ochre/cream corner perimeter block with one central chamfer axis, three regular upper levels, two dormer tiers in a pitched zinc mansard, iron balcony, multi-pot chimneys, and continuously wrapping green cafe canopy with striped central section.
positive_findings: C1 closed: the courtyard, rear, left-side and top views show a joined roof envelope without the former open black wedges, overlapping ridge strip or penetrating attic slabs.
C2 closed: the single central chamfer entrance has a furniture-free approach; the glass and walk views show depth into a furnished interior.
C3 closed: pitched upper zinc planes, two attic tiers and curved dormer crowns retain the source-defining roof grammar. Dormer cheeks and sills meet their carriers.
C4 closed: the chamfer has one stacked window and dormer axis aligned over the central door and balcony.
C5 closed: the wrapping green canopy and striped center form continuous mitered corners, with visible supports.
C6 closed: architecture_close and roof_contact now show clean planar upper roof pitches and straight seams. The sawtooth shading patches and warped seam transitions from v009 are absent.

All 14 elevations and detail views plus three phone boards were inspected against the three exact source images. Ochre and cream facade hierarchy, recessed openings, iron balconies, multi-pot chimneys, cafe programme, grounding and whole-scene framing remain coherent at architectural-clay scope.

nonblocking_notes.finding: Facade course relief, simple cafe chairs and planter foliage remain stylized clay-tier details. Some seam phases do not align across changes of pitch, but the roof planes and joins are clean and physically coherent.

limitations: No user, publication or runtime approval is granted.
Inferred hidden courtyard windows and concept interiors are acceptable within documented assumptions.
This is architectural clay review, not textured keeper approval.
next_gate: Offline architectural-clay visual gate passed. Runtime integration, browser checks and any required human visual/publication approval remain separate gates.

physical_diagnosis.method: Read-only independent arithmetic check of the same straight-skeleton input, followed by full visual inspection of exact exported GLB renders; no model source edits
physical_diagnosis.pixel_confirmation: Clean planar cap, crisp roof folds, straight raised seams, and closed carrier joins in the full v010 evidence set.
